title: Viswasam
desc: Thooku Durai, a strong and respected village leader, faces personal struggles as he tries to reunite with his estranged wife Niranjana and daughter, all while confronting challenges from his past.

title: Disco Raja
desc: A ground-breaking scientific experiment brings a deceased man to life. However, things take a turn when he tries to escape the facility after waking up with no memories.

title: The Warriorr
desc: A man is banished to abandon the city when he rebels against a notorious gangster. However, he returns as DSP of police with a steadfast goal to settle a score.

title: Snake Island Python
desc: A group of explorers set out to search for a magical tree in the jungle and soon find a mysterious creature is waiting to attack them.

title: Thalainagaram 2
desc: Right, a former gangster, swears off violence to become a real estate agent. However, he is forced to return to his old ways when three criminals try to frame him for a crime.

title: PK
desc: An innocent alien lands on Earth but loses his communication device. However, he meets Jaggu, a heartbroken reporter, and tries to find his device with her help.
